# supercarto

> Documentation for supercarto — token-budgeted map context for AI agents: one call returns a walkable topological graph of any coordinate, with weather, terrain, daylight, indoor floors and GTFS transit built in.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs): supercarto gives an AI agent a map of any location on Earth as a token-budgeted topological graph — one call, N tokens, measured on output.
- [Quick start](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/quick-start): Install supercarto, return your first maplet, and wire it into an agent — Node, Python, Claude Desktop, or the hosted endpoint.
- [FAQ](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/faq): Short answers to the questions every evaluation starts with.

## Concepts

- [The budget is a real budget](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/concepts/budget): How output gets ranked, cut, kept connected, and re-measured until the reported number is the delivered number.
- [Honesty rules](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/concepts/honesty): The refusal, absence, and degradation semantics that run through every tool — silence is never punctuality.
- [Accuracy](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/concepts/accuracy): Distances verified against haversine ground truth at mid and high latitude — the Mercator scale correction done per axis.

## Tools

- [The tools](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/tools): The eleven tools a supercarto deployment advertises, and exactly when each one exists.
- [get_maplet](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/tools/get-maplet): The core call — a walkable, token-budgeted topological graph of any coordinate.
- [localize](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/tools/localize): Move an open map session for the cost of the delta, not a new map.
- [route](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/tools/route): Feasibility first — straight-line distance, direction, and walking verification.
- [search_places and expand_feature](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/tools/search-places): Query a maplet by name or type, then expand one feature's exact geometry on demand.
- [get_terrain and get_daylight](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/tools/get-terrain): Ground elevation and slope, sun position, sunrise and sunset — arithmetic and tiles, no keys.
- [get_weather](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/tools/get-weather): Keyless current conditions and forecast, with a degraded path that refuses to invent readings.
- [get_traffic](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/tools/get-traffic): Live congestion with a provider key; labelled free-flow without one.
- [get_transit and get_transit_route](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/tools/get-transit): Schedules, departure boards, live delays, and a certified ride plan — honest in all three service states.

## Interfaces

- [CLI](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/interfaces/cli): Every supercarto command, from fetch to decode, with the flags each one takes.
- [HTTP API](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/interfaces/http): The maplet, screen, transit and route endpoints, with parameters and examples.
- [MCP and Claude Desktop](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/interfaces/mcp): supercarto exposes MCP over stdio; one-click install ships as an MCPB bundle.
- [Python client](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/interfaces/python): An asyncio client with zero runtime dependencies, speaking JSON-RPC to the Node server over stdio.

## Guides

- [Data sources](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/guides/data-sources): Where every layer gets its data — env-controlled, one factory, honest fallbacks.
- [Deployment](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/guides/deployment): Local HTTP, the hosted Cloudflare Worker and its honest subsets, plus documentation site deployment.

## Agent skills

- [supercarto](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/.well-known/agent-skills/supercarto/SKILL.md): Read the supercarto docs instead of answering from memory. Documentation for supercarto — token-budgeted map context for AI agents: one call returns a walkable topological graph of any coordinate, with weather, terrain, daylight, indoor floors and GTFS transit built in. Use when a task involves supercarto: how it works, how to set it up or configure it, or its API.

## Agent resources

- [llms-full.txt](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/llms-full.txt): The full Markdown of every page in one file.
- [Page Markdown](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/index.md): Append `.md` to any page URL to fetch that page as raw Markdown.
- [JSON API](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/api/docs/pages.json): Page index of the JSON docs API; each entry links the page's JSON and Markdown forms. Described by the OpenAPI document at https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/openapi.json.
- [Agent skills](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Agent Skills discovery index of the skills this site publishes.
- [API catalog](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset of the APIs documented here.
- [AI catalog](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): ARD manifest of the agent-facing resources on this site (MCP server, skills, APIs).
- [agent-readability.json](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/agent-readability.json): Manifest of every agent-facing artifact on this site.
- [Sitemap](https://supercarto.pages.dev/docs/sitemap.xml): Every indexable page URL with its last-modified date.
